name: Your Auto Shop
facts: Auto repair shop app: build a quote, book a time, track your car, and pay by QR.
Hours: Mon–Fri 8:00 AM–6:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM–3:00 PM, Sun closed.
Arrival or drop-off windows are 2 hours long, and you can book up to 7 days ahead.
Prices in the app are samples. The final quote comes after the shop inspects your car.
The exact address is sent after your booking is confirmed.
The app is in English and Spanish.
Check-engine codes can be read with a Bluetooth BLE OBD-II adapter. The app only reads codes and never clears them.
Tire stock checker: type your tire size to see if it's in stock.
My Garage is saved on your phone only. There is no account.
Text and email alerts in the app are a demo and are not sent yet.
The pay screen is a demo. No real payment is processed.
The app has no points, rewards, games or birthday club.
suggested: How do I get a price quote?
How do I book a time?
Do you have my tire size in stock?
How do I track my car?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: We're open Mon–Fri 8:00 AM–6:00 PM and Saturday 9:00 AM–3:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.

qa.q: Are you open on Sunday?
qa.a: No, we're closed on Sundays.

qa.q: Are you open on Saturday?
qa.a: Yes, Saturday hours are 9:00 AM–3:00 PM.

qa.q: Are you open right now?
qa.a: The top of the app's home page shows "Open now" with the closing time, or when we open next if we're closed.

qa.q: What time do you close?
qa.a: Mon–Fri we close at 6:00 PM, and Saturday at 3:00 PM.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: Mon–Fri we open at 8:00 AM, and Saturday at 9:00 AM.

qa.q: What's your address?
qa.a: For privacy, the exact address is sent to you after your booking is confirmed.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: The app shows only the city area. You'll get the exact address once your booking is confirmed.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: The number shown in the app is (555) 010-0000. Tap "Call / text" on the home page to reach us.

qa.q: Can I text you?
qa.a: Yes. Tap "Call / text" on the home page and it opens a text message to the shop.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff or call the number shown in the app.

qa.q: Do I need an account or to sign up?
qa.a: No. You can build a quote and book without an account. My Garage is saved on your phone only.

qa.q: How do I get a price for my repair?
qa.a: Tap "Build my quote", pick your car, say what's wrong or tap a spot on the car, and you'll see a price range or "Ask for a quote". Prices are samples until the shop inspects the car.

qa.q: Are the prices final?
qa.a: No. Prices in the app are samples. The final quote comes after inspection.

qa.q: Why does it say "Ask for a quote"?
qa.a: Some services have no price in the app. The shop sets the price after looking at your car.

qa.q: How do I tell you what's wrong with my car?
qa.a: Type it in your own words, like "squeaks when I brake", or tap a glowing spot on the car picture. The app suggests likely repairs and a price.

qa.q: What's the labor rate?
qa.a: The sample labor rate in the app is $95 per hour. The final quote comes after inspection.

qa.q: How do I book a time?
qa.a: Add your repairs, tap "Pick a time", choose a day and an open arrival window, then "Request this job". The shop accepts it with a final quote.

qa.q: How far ahead can I book?
qa.a: You can book up to 7 days ahead.

qa.q: How long is an arrival window?
qa.a: Each window is 2 hours, like 8–10 or 10–12.

qa.q: What do the colors on the booking calendar mean?
qa.a: They show Open, Your pick and Booked windows. Tap an open one to hold it for your job.

qa.q: Why can't I pick a time on some days?
qa.a: The day is either closed or fully booked. Pick another day.

qa.q: When will my car be ready?
qa.a: After you pick a time, the quote shows a "Ready by about" estimate. The final time is confirmed by the shop.

qa.q: Can I cancel or change my request?
qa.a: I don't have cancel or change details. Please ask staff or call the number shown in the app.

qa.q: How do I track my car?
qa.a: Open the Track tab. Every update from the shop shows up under "My requests", from Received through Ready for pickup.

qa.q: What steps does a repair go through?
qa.a: Received, Diagnosing, Waiting on parts, Being worked on, Halfway, Almost done, and Ready for pickup.

qa.q: Can I see a sample of the tracker?
qa.a: Yes. In the Track tab, tap "Play the sample" to watch a sample job.

qa.q: Will I get an alert when my car is almost done?
qa.a: The Alerts tab offers in-app alerts, texts and email. Right now texts and email are a demo and aren't sent. Texts go live once the carriers approve the shop's texting number.

qa.q: How do I turn on alerts?
qa.a: Open the Alerts tab and choose in-app, text or email. For text or email, enter your mobile number or email.

qa.q: What is the bell icon?
qa.a: It opens your alerts inbox with updates on your jobs.

qa.q: What services do you offer?
qa.a: Diagnostics, inspections, oil change, brakes, tires, engine and tune-up, transmission, suspension, steering, electrical, A/C and heating, battery, lights, wipers, doors and windows, exhaust, glass, and detailing. The Services section lists the ones this shop shows.

qa.q: How do I add a service to my job?
qa.a: Tap any service in the Services section, tick the options you want, and save. It's added to your quote.

qa.q: Do you do oil changes?
qa.a: Yes. Options include conventional and full synthetic with sample prices, plus synthetic blend, high-mileage, diesel and fluid services as "Ask for a quote".

qa.q: How much is an oil change?
qa.a: The sample price range is conventional parts $30–45 plus labor, and full synthetic parts $55–85 plus labor. The app shows the total, and the final quote is after inspection.

qa.q: Do you do brakes?
qa.a: Yes: brake pads, pads and rotors, and brake fluid flush. You'll see sample price ranges in the app.

qa.q: Do you fix a check-engine light?
qa.a: Yes. Start with a code scan and inspection, or scan the car yourself in the Scan tab.

qa.q: Do you do tire repair and replacement?
qa.a: Yes: rotation, flat repair, replacing one tire or all four, plus balance, alignment, TPMS and seasonal swaps (quote only).

qa.q: Do you do alignments?
qa.a: Yes. Wheel alignment is listed under Tires and Steering. The Steering alignment is done at a partner shop.

qa.q: Do you work on batteries?
qa.a: Yes: battery and charging test, battery replacement, and terminal cleaning, all with sample prices.

qa.q: Do you do A/C repair?
qa.a: Yes: A/C recharge, leak check, cabin air filter, and quotes for heater, blower and compressor problems.

qa.q: Do you do transmission work?
qa.a: Yes, but transmission jobs are quote-only: diagnosis, fluid service, clutch, leak repair, and rebuild or replace.

qa.q: Do you do windshield and glass repair?
qa.a: Yes, chip repair, windshield replacement, side and back glass, and camera recalibration. All are quote-only.

qa.q: Do you do body work and paint?
qa.a: Body parts and body and paint services are listed, with paint work as "Ask for a quote". Parts arrive primed, and paint matching is quoted separately.

qa.q: Do you do detailing?
qa.a: Yes, as an add-on. Interior, wash and wax, and full detail have sample prices, and ceramic and paint correction are quote-only.

qa.q: Do you do window tint?
qa.a: Yes: front 2 windows, full car, and windshield sun strip, all with sample prices.

qa.q: Do you install sound systems?
qa.a: Yes: head units (CarPlay / Android Auto), speakers, and a sub with amp.

qa.q: Do you come to my house or work?
qa.a: The app shows a mobile call-out service for some versions. In this shop's app, ask staff or call to confirm.

qa.q: Do you do inspections or smog checks?
qa.a: Inspection options include multi-point, pre-purchase, smog, state safety (where required) and road-trip checks, all quote-only.

qa.q: How do I check if my tire size is in stock?
qa.a: Open the Tires tab, type the size from your tire's sidewall, choose how many, and tap Check stock.

qa.q: What tire size formats work?
Where do I find my tire size?
qa.a: It's printed on the side of every tire, like P225/45R17 94V. It's also on the sticker in the driver's door jamb.

qa.q: What does 225/45R17 mean?
qa.a: 225 is the width in millimeters, 45 is the sidewall height as a percent of the width, and R17 means it fits a 17-inch wheel.

qa.q: Can I hold a set of tires?
qa.a: Yes. If your size is in stock, you can hold a set and it's added to your quote.

qa.q: What if my tire size isn't in stock?
qa.a: You can request an order. The sample timing in the app is usually 2–3 business days. The shop confirms the real timing.

qa.q: How much do the tires cost?
qa.a: Tire prices in the stock list say "Ask for a quote" unless the shop sets a price.

qa.q: What is My Garage?
qa.a: It saves your cars, their recalls, scan history, service history and what's due next. It lives only on your phone, with no account and nothing uploaded.

qa.q: How do I save my car?
qa.a: Pick your car (year, make, model or VIN), then tap "Save to My Garage".

qa.q: Can I enter my VIN?
qa.a: Yes. Type the 17-character VIN and tap Decode to fill in your car. A VIN has no I, O or Q.

qa.q: Where do I find my paint code?
qa.a: It's on the sticker in the driver's door jamb. Look for PAINT, C/TR or EXT.

qa.q: Can I see recalls for my car?
qa.a: Yes. Once you pick year, make and model, the app shows NHTSA safety recalls and the most-reported owner complaints. Recall repairs are a free fix at a dealer.

qa.q: Will the app remind me when maintenance is due?
qa.a: My Garage shows what's due, like oil change, tire rotation and brake check, using simple rules of thumb. Your owner's manual wins.

qa.q: How do I scan my check-engine codes?
qa.a: Open the Scan tab. Plug a Bluetooth LE (BLE) ELM327 adapter under the dash, turn the key to ON, and tap Connect. Or type a code like P0420.

qa.q: Which scan adapter should I buy?
qa.a: The app lists Veepeak OBDCheck BLE+, Vgate iCar Pro BLE 4.0, and OBDLink CX. Get a "BLE" or "Bluetooth 4.0" model.

qa.q: Does the scan work on my iPhone?
qa.a: Safari on iPhone can't use Bluetooth. Use the free Bluefy browser, or type your code. Chrome on Android and on a computer also work.

qa.q: Will the scan erase my codes?
qa.a: No. The scan is read-only and never clears codes.

qa.q: Can I try the scan without an adapter?
qa.a: Yes. Tap "Try a demo scan" to see sample data. It isn't your car.

qa.q: Does a code tell me exactly what part is broken?
qa.a: No. Codes point to a system, not a guaranteed part. The mechanic makes the final diagnosis.

qa.q: Do you have anything for Tesla owners?
qa.a: Yes. If you pick a Tesla, the app shows recall info, software update links and service tips. The app never asks for your Tesla password.

qa.q: Can I scan my electric car?
qa.a: Teslas don't use the standard OBD-II port for owner scans. Write down any screen alert (Controls › Service) and type it in, or tell the shop.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: Use the Pay tab: scan the QR code with your phone's camera, pick how you want to pay, and your receipt is texted to you. The pay screen in this app is a demo and no real payment is processed.

qa.q: What payment methods do you accept?
qa.a: The pay screen lists Apple Pay, Google Pay, card (tap or chip), Cash App, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal, and pay over time (Affirm / Klarna). Please confirm with staff.

qa.q: Is the QR pay real?
qa.a: This version is a demo. Nothing is charged and no account is connected.

qa.q: Do you have a counter QR card?
qa.a: Yes. The Pay tab has a printable counter or bay QR card.

qa.q: Do you offer financing?
qa.a: The pay screen lists "Pay over time (Affirm / Klarna)". Ask staff for details.

qa.q: Is there a language option?
qa.a: Yes. Tap EN or ES at the top of the app for English or Spanish.

qa.q: Does the shop have a points or rewards program?
qa.a: This app doesn't show any points or rewards program. Ask staff or call the number shown in the app.

qa.q: Are there games in the app?
qa.a: No, there are no games in this app.

qa.q: Is there a weekly contest or prize?
qa.a: I don't have any contest or prize details. Ask staff or call the number shown in the app.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club or referral bonus?
qa.a: I don't have those details. Ask staff or call the number shown in the app.

qa.q: Are there specials, coupons or discounts?
qa.a: I don't have specials or discounts listed. Ask staff or call the number shown in the app.

qa.q: Do you accept insurance for collision work?
qa.a: The Body & paint service lists "Collision estimate (insurance OK)". Ask staff about your claim.

qa.q: Can I see before and after photos?
qa.a: The before/after section is placeholder art in this version. The shop's real photos go there.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: I don't have install steps. Try your browser's "Add to Home Screen" option, or ask staff.

qa.q: Is my information private?
qa.a: Your car info and My Garage are saved on your phone only. Nothing is uploaded to an account.

qa.q: Are there kid rules?
qa.a: There's no kid mode or kid rules in this app.

qa.q: How do I talk to a person?
qa.a: Tap "Call / text" on the home page, or call the number shown in the app: (555) 010-0000.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: This is a repair shop, so there's no food menu. See the Services section for what we do.
